verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਰਸਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: paaras hoaa paarasahu satigur parache satigur kahanaa|

en.bdb: Meeting paras (the philosopher's stone Guru Nanak) Guru Angad became paras himself and because of his love for the Guru he was called the true Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਚੰਦਨਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਰਹਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan hoiaa cha(n)dhanahu gur upadhes rahat vich rahanaa|

en.bdb: Living according to the preachings and code of conduct laid down by the Guru, he became sandal by meeting the sandal (Guru Nanak).

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੁਖ ਦਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: jot samaanee jot vich gurmat sukh dhuramat dhukh dhahanaa|

en.bdb: The light immersed in the light; the delight of the wisdom of Guru (gurmat) was attained and the sufferings of evil mindedness got burnt and wiped out.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜ ਨੋ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੈ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਮਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: acharaj no acharaj milai visamaadhai visamaadh samahanaa|

en.bdb: The wonder met the wonder and becoming wondrous got imbued with the wonder (Guru Nanak).

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਅਣ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰਣੁ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਣੁ ਅਸਹੀਅਣੁ ਸਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: apiau peean nijhar jharan ajar jaran asaheean sahanaa|

en.bdb: After quaffing the nectar the fountain of joy emerges to flew and then the power of bearing the unbearable is obtained

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਵਹਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: sach samaanaa sach vich gaaddee raahu saadhasa(n)g vahanaa|

en.bdb: Moving on the highway of the holy congregation, the truth has merged into the truth.
In fact Lahana became the light of Baba Nanak's house.
